# TempAmbiQA — external human temporal ambiguity evidence

- Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Bhawna/TempAmbiQA
- Pinned upstream revision: `ba7839ca206d7b68d4d5322e8c286b649d8da587`.
- Raw path: `TempAmbiQA.json`.
- Upstream Git tree entry: `b9432856685169dd40e884570ab511b1c129ba12`, 937,488 bytes.
- SHA-256: `e71fa96f389e45d73c61915461f9b0b3f6207e956fd5b3eb72d19c66cfee9942`.
- Source paper: Bhawna Piryani, Abdelrahman Abdallah, Jamshid Mozafari, and Adam Jatowt (2024), [Detecting Temporal Ambiguity in Questions](https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-emnlp.562/), Findings of EMNLP 2024, pp. 9620–9634.
- Upstream dataset card declares MIT. Source project license: https://github.com/DataScienceUIBK/TempAmbiQA/blob/be356e91280e8f54bdd8ac16d94c4c8af4b7454f/LICENSE

The pinned Hugging Face tree metadata and raw bytes were fetched separately and matched. The repository blob was read back and matched. Counts: 8,162 records, 3,879 temporally ambiguous, 4,283 temporally unambiguous, 8,161 distinct question strings, no conflicting duplicate labels. The source uses other QA datasets, including SituatedQA, ArchivalQA and AmbigQA; do not infer source independence or absence of overlap with other corpora. This is the upstream train split, not a guarantee that a general model has not seen these questions. No annotation is rewritten.
